findings: Across measured 64–1536-token synthetic prefixes, same-host TCP reads have higher median TTFT than recomputation with this small model and backend.
GET time increases with prefix size; for 1536 tokens its median is 72.82 ms, while lookup is about 0.36 ms.

In separate synchronized diagnostics, dense recomputation uses prefill_no_prefix_dense_flash. Cached-prefix processing records prefill_smallq_decode_scalar and prefill_prefix_flash for the eight new tokens.

For 256 tokens the diagnostic first-forward spans are 30.37 ms (recompute) and 52.90 ms (read). For 1536 they are 76.32 and 66.65 ms: this observed compute saving is smaller than the primary GET cost.
Subtracting GET and lookup counters from server TTFT leaves additional work. This residual is not attributed entirely to scheduling; it includes model execution and other framework costs.
The 256-token outlier has lossless KV transport but divergent logits at a tied top candidate. Exact output identity fails for that default-path sample and remains explicit.

With a 64-token prefill scheduling budget in both arms, all six additional paired outputs match, including the original mismatch input. This also makes recomputation much slower and changes the latency ranking; its results are kept separate.
limitations: Primary timing uses six pairs per selected length and four generated tokens per request.
Diagnostic forward spans include CPU launch gaps and instrumentation effects; they are not kernel-only durations.
Conclusions apply to Qwen2.5-1.5B FP16 on V100 with this pinned fork, 160 GPU blocks and same-host TCP.
The VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT compatibility experiment was stopped after showing multi-second latency; it is excluded from primary statistics.

fixed_granularity_correctness_check.purpose: Additional controlled correctness and scheduling-sensitivity check
fixed_granularity_correctness_check.performance_interpretation: Smaller chunks add repeated prefill and scheduling work to recomputation. Its latency is reported separately from the 36-pair normal-budget experiment.
fixed_granularity_correctness_check.caveat: Default 2048-token scheduling still has the recorded 35/36 output boundary.
